scripts.typecheck:all: for d in kova-contracts kova-auth kova-sync kova-sale kova-inventory kova-accounting; do (cd $d && npm run typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:all: for d in kova-contracts kova-auth kova-sync kova-sale kova-inventory kova-accounting; do (cd $d && npm test) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:all: for d in kova-contracts kova-auth kova-sync kova-sale kova-inventory kova-accounting; do (cd $d && npm run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.infra:up: cd kova-infra && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.infra:down: cd kova-infra && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v
